title: 中国癌症年新发病例破500万，胃癌退出前五 | 原文
content: The National Cancer Center reports that China’s new cancer cases in 2024 surpassed 5 million for the first time, reaching 5.15 million. Deaths totaled 2.58 million. Lung, female breast, thyroid, colorectal, and liver cancers ranked as the top five new diagnoses, while lung, liver, colorectal, gastric, and esophageal cancers were the leading causes of death. This data marks a significant shift, notably excluding gastric cancer from the top five diagnoses, highlighting evolving epidemiological trends.
